transcript:
Advisor: Hi Linda, it's Sarah. Happy new year.
Linda: Happy new year! I spent January reading seed catalogs, so I'm in a good mood.
Advisor: Glad to hear it. Your portfolio had a solid year, and the $2,500 monthly distribution continues. We're right on your balanced income target.
Linda: Good. You know how I like it.
Advisor: Steady and boring.
Linda: Exactly. Michael took me to Jack's soccer tournament in December. They won!
Advisor: Congratulations to Jack. Is there anything you'd like to change this year?
Linda: No, keep everything the same. Michael is still my trusted contact.
Advisor: Noted. I'll send the annual tax documents when they're ready.
Linda: Thank you, Sarah. Talk in the summer.
